latitude.definition: Geographic latitude of an observation or platform in decimal degrees north.

longitude.definition: Geographic longitude of an observation or platform in decimal degrees east.

geometry.definition: Point, trajectory, bounding box, polygon, or swath geometry describing spatial coverage.
geometry.notes: Needed for non-point datasets and satellite granules.

observation_time.definition: UTC time at which the observation was made.
observation_time.notes: Preserve native timestamp semantics before UTC normalization.

time_start.definition: Beginning of dataset, deployment, cast, granule, or file coverage.

time_end.definition: End of dataset, deployment, cast, granule, or file coverage.

depth.definition: Depth below the sea surface at which the observation was made.

pressure.definition: Sea-water pressure at sample level, commonly used instead of geometric depth for profiles.
pressure.notes: Keep both pressure and derived depth when possible.

depth_min.definition: Shallowest sampled depth of a record/profile/file/dataset.

depth_max.definition: Deepest sampled depth of a record/profile/file/dataset.

vertical_reference.definition: Reference and direction for vertical coordinate, such as below sea surface, station datum, ellipsoid, geoid, or seafloor.
vertical_reference.notes: Critical for sea level and bathymetry.

platform_id.definition: Stable native identifier for float, buoy, ship, glider, animal tag, station, satellite, etc.

wmo_wigos_id.definition: WMO/WIGOS identifier used to cross-reference operational observing platforms.

platform_type.source_examples: float, drifter, mooring, ship, glider, tide_gauge

platform_model.definition: Model/type of observing platform or buoy/float.

instrument_type.definition: Type of instrument that generated the observation.

instrument_model.definition: Manufacturer/model of the sensor or instrument.

network_program.definition: Observing network or program responsible for the observation.

dataset_id.definition: Provider-native dataset, collection, deployment, or product identifier.

record_id.definition: Provider-native identifier for profile, cast, occurrence, sounding, or granule.

cruise_id.definition: Identifier for research cruise, expedition, voyage, or expocode.

station_id.definition: Station or fixed-site identifier within a cruise/network.

cast_profile_id.definition: Identifier for individual vertical profile, cast, or float cycle.

project.definition: Scientific or operational project associated with the observation.

provider.definition: Institution or organization that generated, manages, or distributes the observation.

country.definition: Country, agency, or national program associated with the observation.

qc_flag.definition: Source-native quality-control flag associated with the observation.

qc_normalized.definition: App-level normalized QC class mapped from source flags.

data_mode.definition: Processing maturity such as real-time, provisional, delayed-mode, research-quality, or best-copy.

uncertainty.definition: Quantified uncertainty or error estimate supplied by the source.

processing_level.definition: Processing stage such as raw, adjusted, L2P, L3, L4, synthesis, or analysis.
processing_level.notes: Important to distinguish observation from analysis.

method.definition: Method used to collect or calculate a value.

sampling_protocol.definition: Protocol or sampling method, especially for biological records.

wavelength_nm.definition: Optical wavelength associated with a spectral measurement.
wavelength_nm.notes: Extract from names like Rrs443 or BBP700.

wave_partition.definition: Wave system represented by the variable.

direction_convention.definition: Whether a direction points toward motion or indicates the direction from which it comes.

sst_subtype.definition: Physical SST layer represented by a surface-temperature product.

ph_scale.definition: Chemical pH scale on which the reported value is defined.
ph_scale.notes: pH is not safely comparable without this.

reference_temperature.definition: Temperature to which a derived chemical value such as pH or fCO2/pCO2 has been normalized.

reference_pressure.definition: Pressure to which a derived quantity such as potential temperature or pH has been normalized.

carbon_wet_dry_basis.definition: Whether CO2 mole fraction/pressure is reported on a wet or dry gas basis.

salinity_scale.definition: Definition used for salinity, e.g. PSS-78 practical salinity or TEOS-10 absolute salinity.

datum.definition: Vertical datum/reference for tide gauge, SSH, bathymetry, or elevation.

taxon_id.definition: Stable taxonomic identifier such as WoRMS AphiaID.

scientific_name.definition: Scientific taxon name represented by a biological record.

occurrence_status.definition: Detection/non-detection status for a taxon occurrence.

sampling_effort.definition: Amount of search/sampling effort associated with a biological observation.
sampling_effort.notes: Needed to interpret absence and abundance.

provenance.definition: Lineage from observing network through aggregator/product to the record delivered to the app.

non_merge_rules.Examples: TEMP / WTMP / SST / SSTskin / SSTsubskin / SSTfnd / THETA
non_merge_rules.Rule: Do not flatten to one number type.
non_merge_rules.App implementation: Show parent 'Temperature' but preserve canonical key and SST subtype/reference pressure. In-situ water temperature, surface temperature, potential temperature and GHRSST SST layers represent different physical quantities.
Group under 'Salinity'; preserve salinity scale and surface/profile context. Practical Salinity (PSS-78) is not the same quantity as TEOS-10 Absolute Salinity.
Pressure can be converted approximately to depth using latitude; sample depth is not bottom depth. Keep original vertical coordinate and vertical reference.
Normalize only after recording direction_convention: winds/waves are normally FROM, currents are normally TO.
Expose 'Wave period' parent with subtype dominant, peak, mean_m10, mean_m02, etc.

non_merge_rules.Examples: WVHT / VHM0 / WWH / S1HT / S2HT / VCMX
non_merge_rules.App implementation: Expose 'Wave height' parent; preserve total/wind-wave/swell partition and significant vs maximum statistic.
Map concentration products together after unit normalization; never merge oxygen saturation percentage with concentration.
Use nitrate_plus_nitrite when the source cannot distinguish nitrate from nitrate+nitrite.

non_merge_rules.Rule: Same conceptual parent, not directly comparable.
non_merge_rules.App implementation: One UI label 'pH' is acceptable, but require qualifiers for pH scale, reference temperature and reference pressure; warn if unknown.
Display under parent 'CO2 / carbonate system' but keep fCO2, pCO2 and xCO2 as separate canonical variables.
Do not treat raw fluorescence as concentration. Keep measurement method/algorithm; calibrated concentration can map to chlorophyll-a.
Keep particulate and total backscatter separate; extract wavelength as metadata.
Use one canonical variable per physical quantity with wavelength_nm, rather than hundreds of wavelength-specific UI names.

non_merge_rules.Examples: tide-gauge sea_level / SSH / SLA / ADT / MDT / MSS
non_merge_rules.App implementation: Use a Sea Level parent group but do not merge; preserve datum/geoid/ellipsoid/mean field and processing level.
L2P can represent observation-level satellite retrievals; L4 is gap-filled analysis. Mark processing level so the app does not count L4 cells as independent observations.
DCDB soundings are measurements. GEBCO is a gridded synthesis containing measured and inferred sources; keep product class/provenance.
Use individual count only for counts. organismQuantity requires organismQuantityType and unit; biomass needs wet/dry/carbon basis and normalization.

non_merge_rules.Examples: concentration / edge / type / drift / thickness / freeboard
non_merge_rules.App implementation: Group under Sea Ice but keep separate canonical variables; preserve algorithm/product and interval for drift.
